name: cosmos
description: Research screenshot flows, generate design tokens, implement with real components and verify rendered UI.

interface.longDescription: Cosmos searches and opens design references, generates design files with UI/UX Pro Max, verifies HeroUI components and exact theSVG brand assets, and compares the rendered interface with its references.
capabilities: Generate design tokens and use real UI components
Verify code and rendered interface evidence
defaultPrompt: Search the design library for Grok chat screens.
Design an original SwiftUI chat using Cosmos references.
Audit my landing page for mobile layout and keyboard access.

publication.release_notes: Use annotated full landing pages to map the hero, product demonstrations and conversion to observable design decisions. Includes a tested motion example and opt-in local project style.

fr-FR.subtitle: Design et références visuelles
fr-FR.description: Cosmos relie les références visuelles à de vrais fichiers de design, aux composants HeroUI, aux logos theSVG et à la vérification du rendu.
